official.deadline_note: AY 2026-27 student application window per the official revised timeline ran 27 February to 22 April 2026; the A2A portal now shows registration for 2026-27 closed. Indian Missions may apply their own earlier submission cut-offs within the portal window.
official.application_cycle: 2026-27 cycle (A2A portal open to students 27 February - 22 April 2026)
official.status_note: The A2A portal homepage states that scholarship registration for the academic year 2026-27 is closed; the published revised timeline gave 27 February - 22 April 2026 for student applications, with university scrutiny to 31 May 2026 and Mission selection to 30 June 2026.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Tuition fee/other compulsory fee (excluding refundable fee) is paid by ICCR directly to the University/Institution as per the financial norms attached to the scheme.
benefits: Monthly stipend of INR 18,000 (Undergraduate), INR 20,000 (Postgraduate) and INR 22,000 (M.Phil/Ph.D.), payable from the date of joining the Institute on a pro-rata basis
House Rent Allowance of INR 6,500 per month in Grade I cities and INR 5,500 per month in other cities, paid along with the monthly stipend
Annual contingent allowance of INR 5,000 (UG), INR 7,000 (PG) and INR 12,500 (Ph.D.)
One-time thesis and dissertation expenses of INR 10,000 for Ph.D. scholars and INR 7,000 for other courses requiring submission of a project
Tuition fee/other compulsory fee paid directly to the Universities/Institutions as per the attached norms
Return economy class airfare to the airport nearest to the place of study plus 3-tier AC train fare, provided for students of Mexico and Turkmenistan only
eligibility: Nationals of the 23 countries with valid Cultural Exchange Programmes/Educational Exchange Programmes with India: 21 without airfare (Australia, Belarus, Brazil, Bulgaria, Canada, Chile, China, Cyprus, France, Guyana, Indonesia, Israel, Malaysia, Norway, Romania, Russia, Spain, Suriname, Syria, Uzbekistan, Yemen) and 2 with airfare (Mexico, Turkmenistan)
Minimum age 18 years for any level; maximum age 35 years for UG, PG, Certificate and Diploma courses and 40 years for Ph.D. courses, as on 1 July of the academic year
Passport with a minimum validity of two years as on 1 July of the academic year
PIO/OCI applicants must have completed schooling up to XII standard abroad and not studied in India during the preceding five academic years (Ph.D.) or three years (PG)
STEM and Non-STEM streams are offered; Medical, Law and Integrated courses are prohibited
Scholarships are provided only for structured courses of one year or more at UG, PG, Ph.D. level; certificate courses only in Indian Languages/Literature, Performing/Visual Arts and Yoga
requirements: Application online through the A2A portal only; one application per academic year (multiple registrations are prohibited)

Proficiency in English sufficient to attend lectures and complete coursework, meeting the criteria determined by the Indian Mission, plus mandatory submission of a 500-word essay in English on a topic listed on the A2A Portal
Choice of up to five universities/institutes and courses in order of priority
Ph.D. applicants must submit a synopsis of the research topic along with the application, with data collection to be carried out in India
Performing arts applicants must upload the latest video/YouTube link of their performance
Science/engineering UG applicants must have studied Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry at Standard XII; MBA applicants may need a GMAT score at some universities
documents: Passport-size photograph with white background and visibility of both ears, per portal specifications
500-word essay in English on a topic listed on the A2A Portal
Original academic qualification documents from school education onwards, with notarized English translation if not in English
Certified copy of the transcript/syllabus of the last qualifying examination
Medical Fitness Certificate with test reports and vaccination certificates issued by a reputed hospital/lab
English Proficiency certificates (TOEFL/IELTS) if any, Ph.D. research synopsis, AIU Equivalence Certificate if applicable, and the Joining Report form downloadable from the A2A Portal
selection_criteria: Universities/Institutions independently scrutinize applications and upload provisional admission confirmation on the A2A portal
Indian Missions select candidates for the award of scholarship on merit within the slots allocated to the country under the scheme
Selection is the sole discretion of the Indian Mission, which reserves the right to accept or reject any application at any stage without assigning any reason
Grant of admission by one or more universities does not guarantee the award of a scholarship
Some universities may conduct an interview before selecting Ph.D. candidates
coverage: Monthly stipend to cover living costs, paid from the date of joining the Institute on a pro-rata basis
House Rent Allowance of INR 6,500/month in Grade I cities and INR 5,500/month in other cities
Tuition fee/other compulsory fee paid directly to the University/Institution per the attached norms
Annual contingent grant and a one-time thesis/dissertation allowance for research students
Return economy class airfare and 3-tier AC train fare only for students of Mexico and Turkmenistan; not available for the other 21 countries
application_method: Register on the A2A portal and complete the online application (only online applications are accepted)
Submit the application through the Indian Embassy/Indian Mission in your own country
Universities scrutinize the application and upload provisional admission confirmation on the A2A portal
Indian Mission selects candidates and issues an offer letter that must be accepted on the portal within 7 days, with medical fitness uploaded within the prescribed time
official.application_route: Apply online only via the A2A portal (a2ascholarships.iccr.gov.in) and submit through the Indian Mission in your own country
official.citizenship_residency: Open only to nationals of the 23 countries holding valid CEP/EEPs with India; applications are submitted through the Indian Mission in the applicant's own country
official.international_eligibility: Only foreign nationals of the 23 covered countries are eligible; not open to Indian nationals
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: STEM and Non-STEM structured courses at ICCR-empanelled Indian universities/institutes; Medical, Law and Integrated courses are excluded. The scheme is administered by ICCR under the Cultural Exchange Programme/Educational Exchange Programme signed between India and the respective country, and terms are governed by those agreements.
official.research_requirement: Ph.D. applicants must submit a synopsis of the research topic with the application; the research topic must not involve data collection in the home country or any other country outside India; admission in research courses is provided only at Ph.D. level and a university interview may be required
official.duration: For the duration of the enrolled structured course; the prescribed tenure of scholarship for a regular Ph.D. student is 3 years, extendable at ICCR's discretion in blocks of up to six months to a maximum of two years, with a special viva-voce extension of up to six months for which no stipend is paid
official.description: Under the Cultural Exchange Programme/Educational Exchange Programme signed between India and other foreign countries, ICCR offers slots for pursuing UG/PG/Ph.D. courses, a one-year Hindi certificate course (for Bulgaria and China nationals) and Buddhist Studies course (for Lao PDR nationals). The slots are offered only to those countries where valid CEP/EEPs exist, and terms and conditions are governed by the terms and conditions of the CEP/EEPs.
official.region: Countries across Asia, Europe, the Americas and Oceania (23 CEP/EEP countries)
official.program_type: Government of India cultural exchange scholarship (formerly CEP/EEP Scholarship Scheme) for foreign students at UG, PG and Ph.D. levels
official.english_requirement: No fixed IELTS/TOEFL score is published. Classes are conducted in English for all courses, and applicants must be proficient enough to attend lectures and complete coursework, fulfill the English proficiency criteria determined by the Indian Mission, and mandatorily submit a 500-word essay in English on a topic listed on the A2A Portal; TOEFL/IELTS certificates may optionally be uploaded as proof.

not_confirmed: Application dates for the next (2027-28) cycle, which have not been announced on the official pages
Country-specific or university-specific submission cut-offs set by individual Indian Missions

applicant_utility.summary: This is a quota-based exchange scholarship rather than an open call: only nationals of the 23 countries holding a cultural or educational exchange agreement with India can apply, and most countries carry just 2-6 slots. The 2026-27 round shut on 22 April 2026, so the realistic target is the cycle that opens around late February 2027 - track the A2A portal itself rather than aggregator sites. You are covered for tuition, a monthly stipend of INR 18,000-22,000 and house rent allowance, but only Mexican and Turkmenistani students receive airfare, every scholar must self-fund a mandatory health insurance policy, and you should carry roughly USD 1,500 because the first stipend is released only after the SBI account and joining report formalities are completed.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Nationals of the 23 CEP/EEP countries - especially China, Bulgaria, Israel, Spain, Syria, Yemen, Uzbekistan, Romania, Turkmenistan and Mexico, which hold the largest PG/PhD quotas - who want non-medical, non-law structured degrees at empanelled Indian universities.
application_readiness_checklist: Verify your country appears on the scheme's 2026-27 country list with slots at your course level before investing time in the application.
Check passport validity - it must run for at least two years from 1 July of the intake year.
Obtain notarized English translations of every academic certificate now, since originals with translations are verified on arrival.
Draft the mandatory 500-word English essay on one of the topics listed on the A2A portal before the cycle opens.
Ph.D. applicants: write a synopsis whose data collection happens inside India and prepare for a possible university interview.
Budget about USD 1,500 for arrival costs such as hostel or mess deposits, insurance and FRRO fees, as no allowance is paid until formalities complete.
common_rejection_risks: Registering twice in one academic year - multiple applications lead to cancellation of all of them, even after the award or after joining.
Any mismatch between portal entries and uploaded documents, or falsification of date of birth, voids the application and can trigger refund demands and a forgery case under BNS 2023.
Applying for medical, para-medical, law or 5-year integrated courses, which no ICCR scheme funds.
Missing the 7-day window to accept the Mission's offer letter on the portal, or failing to upload the medical fitness certificate within the prescribed time.
Choosing universities without checking their prerequisites, such as a GMAT score for MBA at some universities or Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry at Standard XII for science UG courses.
PIO/OCI applicants who studied in India within the preceding five academic years (Ph.D.) or three years (PG) are not eligible.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Hostel or private accommodation and mess charges, security deposits and caution money, the mandatory medical health insurance with a minimum INR 500,000 cover (paid by the student), FRRO registration and renewal fees, AIU equivalence certificate charges, excess baggage on flights, and - for the 21 countries without the airfare provision - your own international round-trip travel to India.
document_audit: Academic certificates must be carried in original with notarized English translations when issued in another language.
The photograph must have a white background with both ears clearly visible, exactly per the portal's specification.
The transcript/syllabus of the last qualifying examination must be a certified copy and is checked on arrival.
The medical fitness certificate needs test reports and vaccination certificates from a reputed hospital or lab, and the Mission may accept or reject it without assigning reasons.
The Ph.D. synopsis must avoid data collection outside India, and performing-arts applicants must upload a current performance video or YouTube link.
alerts: AY 2026-27 closed on 22 April 2026; the next cycle is expected to open around February 2027 but no official date has been announced yet.
Airfare is country-specific under this scheme: only Mexico and Turkmenistan receive it, while the other 21 countries fund their own travel.

Allowances stop or are reduced if you fail an academic year, remain outside India beyond 60 days in a year (50% stipend deduction beyond 30 days), or miss semester progress reports - a repeat year must be self-financed.
You may not work in India during the scholarship and must leave within two months of your final result declaration.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register once on the A2A portal, complete the form and uploads, submit through your Indian Mission, wait for university scrutiny and provisional admission on the portal, then accept the Mission's offer within 7 days and upload medical fitness before pre-departure and visa formalities.
